map.120 BPM → 四分音符 = 60000/120 = 500 ms；八分 =: At 120 BPM a quarter note = 60000/120 = 500 ms; an eighth = 250 ms, a sixteenth = 125 ms and a dotted quarter = 500×1.5 = 750 ms.
map.120 BPM 下每拍 500 ms；要 LFO 每拍一个周期，频率 = 100: At 120 BPM each beat lasts 500 ms. For an LFO with one cycle per beat, frequency = 1000/500 = 2 Hz. At a sample rate of 44100 Hz a quarter note equals round(500/1000×44100) = 22050 samples.
map.BPM 和毫秒怎么互转？: How Do You Convert Between BPM and Milliseconds?
map.四分音符毫秒 = 60000 / BPM；已知某音符毫秒 ms，对应 BPM =: Quarter-note milliseconds = 60000 / BPM; given the milliseconds ms of a note, the matching BPM = 60000 × beats of that note / ms (for example an eighth note is 0.5 beats).
map.LFO 同步频率怎么算？: How Do You Compute LFO Sync Frequency?
map.周期毫秒 = 四分音符毫秒 × 倍数（每拍=1、每两拍=2），频率(Hz) =: Period milliseconds = quarter-note milliseconds × multiplier (1 for every beat, 2 for every two beats), and frequency (Hz) = 1000 / period milliseconds. For example once per bar (4 beats) gives 1000/(500×4) = 0.5 Hz.
